introduction: In addition to showing the meaning of loving one's fellow man and how precious human life is, this film tells about the difficult, meticulous work and humane spirit of an investigator. In this film, a recessive criminal, Badarch, and teenagers Saruul and Erdene take advantage of their weaknesses to commit a robbery and then give them alcohol. lead to the wrong path. They were involved in a murder case after killing Ochir, a citizen they met by chance while driving drunk. During the investigation of this case, the investigator Ulambayar met with various people and pointed out the psychological and moral issues of the society.
